scene: Your umbrella tip sparks, unlocking three bustling transit gates along the park.
picture: A side view along Puddle Park. The player in yellow raincoat and green boots stands centre, holding her red umbrella pointed at a sparkling puddle. On the far left, a neon ferry sits docked at water. Up high, an orange cable car waits at a tower. On the far right, subway stairs glow.
shown: a sleek neon ferry moored at a wooden pier on the far left
an orange cable car hanging open at a pylon platform up high
a glowing turquoise subway stairwell descending underground on the far right

variants.scene: Sparkling energy ripples across the wet grass, powering up routes around the misty harbour.
Bright blue magic zaps through the puddle, opening your path to find {quest}.
Lightning hums in the puddle as city travel lines suddenly chime to life.
